purpose: Document first-party local registry context, discovery queries, and bounded anonymous parcel-service review.
assessment: Official District Morena pages identify MP Bhulekh as the public route for village spatial and non-spatial land records and link Morena GIS as a district GIS platform. Direct anonymous requests to both linked portals timed out before current viewer configuration, service endpoints, schema/CRS, native parcel identity or geometry could be inspected. No parcel polygon is retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre context is evidenced: the District Morena administration names Tahsil Office Morena at the Collectorate and directs users to MP Bhulekh for land records. This supports registryFound=true for local administrative custody/context, but does not qualify a runtime adapter or prove citywide parcel coverage.
